section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: This graph represents the revenue in dollars that a company expects if they sell their product for \(p\) dollars.

image.alt: Graph of non linear function." height="196

list.item: Based on this model, which price would generate more revenue for the company, \($5\) or \($17\)?

solution.para: Correct! \($5\), as it would generate about \($3,700\) in revenue. Charging \($17\) would bring in about \($2,500\).

list.item: At what price (in dollars) should the company sell their product if they wish to make as much revenue as possible?

solution.para: Correct! Based on the graph, a price of \($10\) would bring in the most revenue.

list.item: How much revenue (in dollars) would they make?

solution.para: Correct! Based on the graph, a price of \($10\) would bring in about \($5,000\).

list.item: What is an appropriate domain for the function? Explain how you know.

problem.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.

solution.para: Compare your answer: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.
\(0 \leq p \leq 20\), because the price has to be non-negative, and the company would earn negative revenue if the price were more than \($20\).
